skeleton: slender ostrich-like Gallimimus mid-stride on two long thin legs, three-quarter view facing left: root at the ground under the feet; body (pivot at the hips) with belly squash, the body piece carrying a short unoutlined stump of the neck's base and its back running into the root of the tail (soft unoutlined cut the tail tucks under); a feathers bone on the belly for the back tuft (fluffs up); neck (one long piece, base faded in over the stump) and the head on it (own chin line, feather tuft), face with eyes (the near one big, the far one a small sliver on the head's front outline above the beak), one brow and the beak's mouths (smile, open, o, sad, yawn, sob, no teeth); armL (far, shaded, behind the chest) and armR (near, over the neck base) at the shoulders; two-part legs: legL/legR thighs at the hips (far one shaded behind the tummy, near one with a faded top over the body) and kneeL/kneeR shins with feet (faded tops under the knees); tail behind the body. Moves are hand keys made from human.run / upright.walk gaits with the feet re-grounded for the two-part bird legs (the gait's own ground solver sank the swinging foot).

sheets.prompt:
Image 1 is a sticker of a slender, sprightly sunny-yellow Gallimimus, an ostrich-like dinosaur running on its two long thin legs, turned a little to the left: a small round head with a little closed beak and a tuft of feathers on top, on a long neck; two short arms held forward; a long tail held out behind; a tuft of soft orange-tipped feathers on its back. Draw this exact Gallimimus as a cut-out paper puppet: its separate body parts laid out on one sheet, the same drawing style, colours, texture, line and proportions as in image 1, every part at the size it has in image 1.

Draw each part on its own, spread out over the sheet with wide empty gaps between them, no part touching or overlapping another:
1. the body: the slender yellow body with its cream chest and tummy and its orange spots, turned as in image 1, without head, without neck, without arms, without legs, without tail and WITHOUT the tuft of feathers on its back: where the feathers lie on its back in image 1, draw only the plain spotted yellow back with its smooth outline; no arms, hands, thighs, legs or feet drawn on it, the tummy one smooth rounded line. At the front, where the long neck rises, the cream chest and the yellow shoulders carry on up only a little, into a short, wide stump of the neck's base, about as tall as it is wide, ending in a full, smooth, rounded top with NO outline across it. At the back, the spotted back and the cream underside run on smoothly into the very root of the tail and end there in a soft edge cut straight down, with NO outline across it (the tail tucks under it): no round rump, no bump, no line where the tail would join. The drawing's dark outline runs only along the front of the chest, round the tummy and along the back.
2. the long slender neck alone, drawn UPSIDE DOWN (turned half a turn, as if hanging from its base): its thick base, where it grows out of the shoulders, at the TOP, as wide as the neck is where it meets the chest in image 1, a soft straight edge with NO outline across it; its narrow top end, just under the head, at the BOTTOM, a full, smooth, rounded end with NO outline across it. As long as the neck of image 1 from the shoulders up to the head, almost straight, the cream throat along one long side and the spotted yellow back of the neck along the other; the dark outline only down its two long sides.
3. the head alone, without neck: the small round yellow head with its orange spots, its rosy cheek, the soft tuft of orange-tipped feathers on top of its head and its little brown closed beak, turned as in image 1, with a completely blank face: no eyes, no eyebrows and no mouth line, the beak one smooth closed shape; keep the rosy cheek, the spots, the feather tuft and the little bump on the head's front outline above the beak where the far eye sits. Keep its dark outline over the top of the head, round the beak and along the jaw under the beak to the chin, as in image 1. From the chin round to the back of the head its bottom edge is soft, with NO outline: the cream throat and the yellow back of the neck simply stop there, just below the rosy cheek.
4. the feathers of its back: the tuft of soft, layered yellow feathers with orange tips and spots that lies along its back in image 1, drawn whole as in image 1, its base (where it grows from the back) a soft edge with NO outline across it.
5. the tail: the long spotted yellow tail with its cream underside and its fringe of soft orange-tipped feathers, held out and up as in image 1, drawn whole from its thick root (normally hidden inside the body) to its feathery tip; its root a full, smooth, rounded end with NO outline across it.
6. the far arm: the short thin arm on the left of image 1, reaching forward, drawn whole from the top of its shoulder (normally hidden behind the chest) down to its little hand with three soft, round, blunt brown fingers, bent as in image 1; its top a full, smooth, rounded end with NO outline across it.
7. the near arm: the short arm on the right of image 1, held forward in front of the chest, drawn whole from the top of its round shoulder down to its little hand with three soft, round, blunt brown fingers, bent as in image 1; its top a full, smooth, rounded end with NO outline across it.
8. the far thigh: the top of the far leg (the leg on the left of image 1, reaching forward), normally hidden behind the cream tummy, drawn whole and straight from the top of the thigh down to the knee just under the tummy; its top a full, smooth, rounded end with NO outline across it, its knee end full, smooth and rounded with the drawing's line round it.
9. the far lower leg: the rest of that far leg below the knee, drawn whole as in image 1: from a full, smooth, rounded knee end with NO outline across it, down the shin to the ankle that bends backwards, then the long slender foot bone reaching forward and down to the foot with three long, soft, blunt brown toes.
10. the near thigh: the big feathered yellow thigh of the near leg (the leg on the right of image 1, reaching back), drawn whole from the top of the thigh down to the knee; its top a full, smooth, rounded end with NO outline across it, its knee end full, smooth and rounded with the drawing's line round it.
11. the near lower leg: the rest of the near leg below the knee, drawn whole as in image 1: from a full, smooth, rounded knee end with NO outline across it, down the long slender shin and foot bone to its foot with three long, soft, blunt brown toes.

Every part is drawn whole, including what is normally hidden behind another part, and each joint end (where it tucks under the body or another part) is a full, smooth, rounded edge. Nothing sharp: no teeth, no pointed claws. No text, no labels, no numbers, no outline around the parts beyond the drawing's own line, no shadows. Fully transparent background.

Image 1 is a sticker of a slender, sunny-yellow Gallimimus with a little closed beak; image 2 shows the same Gallimimus cut into puppet parts, with a blank face. Draw the Gallimimus's face pieces as separate stickers on one sheet: the same drawing style, colours and line as in image 1, every piece at the size it has on the Gallimimus in image 1, so it fits the blank face in image 2. Its small head is turned to the left: its far eye (on the left of image 1) is only a small, narrow dark sliver peeking out on the head's front outline just above the beak, much smaller than its big round near eye (on the right of image 1). In image 1 both eyes look to the left: the near eye's big dark-brown iris with its white sparkle sits towards the left of the eye, the white on its right, outlined in dark brown, with a thin dark-brown eyebrow arch above it.

Draw each piece on its own, upright, in four tidy rows with wide empty gaps between them, nothing touching:
Row 1, the far eye (the small narrow sliver on the LEFT of image 1), six times:
1. as it is in image 1: a small, narrow, tall dark-brown sliver of an eye with a tiny white sparkle.
2. wide open and surprised: a little bigger and rounder, a dark iris with a white sparkle, looking the same way.
3. closed in a happy smile: a short upward-curving arc, like an upside-down U.
4. sad: a small narrow dark eye with a white sparkle, looking down and to the left; no lid slanting across it.
5. crying: squeezed shut, a short thick lid line curving down at both ends like a little frown, and one tiny light-blue teardrop just below it.
6. gently closed in sleep: a short soft downward-curving line with two short lashes.
Row 2, the near eye (the big round eye on the RIGHT of image 1), the same six in the same order:
7. as it is in image 1: a big round eye, its big dark-brown iris with a white sparkle towards the left, the white on its right, outlined in dark brown.
8. wide open and surprised: bigger and rounder, a warm amber iris with a dark pupil and a white sparkle, looking the same way.
9. closed in a happy smile: an upward-curving arc, like an upside-down U, with two little lashes at its right end.
10. sad: open and round, a soft brown iris with a white sparkle looking down and to the left, a thin shine of a welling tear along its bottom rim; no lid slanting across it.
11. crying: squeezed shut, a thick lid line as wide as the open eye, curving down at both ends like a little frown, and one small light-blue teardrop just below its outer (right) end.
12. gently closed in sleep: a soft downward-curving line as wide as the open eye, with a few short lashes.
Row 3: 13. the near eyebrow (over the right eye of image 1) as it is in image 1, a thin dark-brown arch. 14. the same eyebrow worried: tilted up at its inner (left) end.
Row 4, the beak's mouths, none with any teeth: 15. the mouth as it is in image 1: a thin, dark, closed smiling line running back from near the tip of the beak along it, curling up into a little smile at its right end. 16. the whole little brown beak open wide in a big happy laugh: the upper beak lifted, the lower beak dropped, the inside pink with a little pink tongue, no teeth. 17. the whole beak open a little in a small round 'o', the inside pink. 18. the mouth in a small sad frown: a thin closed line along the beak curving down at its right end. 19. the whole beak wide open in a big round 'O', as for a big yawn or a happy call, the inside pink with a little tongue, no teeth. 20. the whole beak sobbing: a little open and turned down, a little pink inside.

No text, no labels, no numbers, no shadows, no face or head around the pieces. Fully transparent background.

Image 1 is a sticker of a slender, sunny-yellow Gallimimus running on two long thin legs; image 2 shows the same Gallimimus cut into puppet parts. In image 2 its near leg (the big leg on the right of image 2) is drawn in one piece; draw that near leg again cut at the knee into two cut-out puppet parts, so the puppet can bend at the knee: the same drawing style, colours, texture, line and proportions as in images 1 and 2, every part at the size it has in image 2.

Draw each part on its own, far apart on the sheet with wide empty gaps between them, nothing touching:
1. the near thigh: exactly the top of that near leg of image 2, the big feathered yellow thigh, from its full rounded top (with NO outline across it) down to the knee, where the leg narrows and turns orange; its knee end a full, smooth, rounded end with the drawing's line round it.
2. the near lower leg with its foot: exactly the rest of that near leg of image 2 below the knee, hanging as it does there: from a full, smooth, rounded knee end with NO outline across it, down the long slender orange shin and foot bone to its foot with three long, soft, blunt brown toes.

No text, no labels, no numbers, no outline around the parts beyond the drawing's own line, no shadows. Fully transparent background.

animations.description: the Gallimimus runs along on its long legs, fast and springy, its neck stretched forward and its tail held out straight, then stops.
the Gallimimus walks along on its long legs, its head bobbing a little with each step, then stops.
the Gallimimus crouches, springs up high for joy with its long legs tucked and lands with a little bounce.
the Gallimimus shakes its head no.
the Gallimimus stretches its neck to look far ahead, then looks up and back the other way, then back.

pause.shows: the Gallimimus with its neck stretched forward, looking far ahead

animations.description: the Gallimimus laughs and laughs, its head tipped up, its body bouncing with giggles.
the Gallimimus does a happy little dance, bobbing its long neck and swishing its tail from side to side.
the Gallimimus cries, its head hanging low, its body shaking with little sobs.
the Gallimimus gives a big yawn, tucks its head down and falls asleep standing up, then wakes up, blinks and smiles.

pause.shows: the Gallimimus fast asleep standing up, eyes shut, head drooped on its long neck

animations.description: the Gallimimus lifts one little hand and waves hello.
the Gallimimus crouches low with its neck stretched forward and its tail out straight, eager and ready to race.

the Gallimimus dips its long neck and pecks at a tasty bite low in the ferns, peck, peck, peck, then looks up with a happy smile.
